declarations.type:
∀ (decision : SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopDecision),
  have semanticCandidate :=
    SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.projectGraphCandidate SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.cacheCollisionContext
      [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.semanticOnlyCacheStep decision] true true;
  have prefixCandidate :=
    SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.projectGraphCandidate SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.cacheCollisionContext
      [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.prefixOnlyCacheStep decision] true true;
  SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse semanticCandidate prefixCandidate ∧
    SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse prefixCandidate semanticCandidate ∧
      SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.traceSemanticSearchCacheSavings
            [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.semanticOnlyCacheStep decision] =
          8 ∧
        SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.tracePrefixCacheSavings
              [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.semanticOnlyCacheStep decision] =
            0 ∧
          SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.traceSemanticSearchCacheSavings
                [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.prefixOnlyCacheStep decision] =
              0 ∧
            SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.tracePrefixCacheSavings
                [SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.prefixOnlyCacheStep decision] =
              8
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectTraceCost.equal_total_cost_does_not_identify_cache_layer
